summary.text: Nantasha Williams represents the 27th District on the New York City Council in Southeast Queens, including Jamaica, St. Albans, Hollis, Queens Village and Springfield Gardens.
Her Council biography says she is Deputy Speaker and chairs the Committee on Cultural Affairs, Libraries and International Relations.

paragraphs.text: According to her Council biography, Williams holds a PhD in Social Welfare and a Master's in Public Administration.
She is the founder and President Emeritus of the NYC Black Women's Political Club and helped lead the Women's March on Washington.

Her legislative record includes protections against deed and mortgage fraud, and the biography says she led passage of the Jamaica Neighborhood Plan, which would deliver up to 12,000 new homes in Downtown Jamaica.
